findings.title: SFC issues restriction notice to DA YUE Financial Group Limited

rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 24 November 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • The SFC has restricted DA YUE Financial Group Limited (DYFGL) from conducting its licensed activities or dealing with relevant property without prior written consent, to preserve client assets. • The SFC’s initial enquiries indicate an approximately HK$29.6 million client-money shortfall involving futures-margin requirements and losses for other clients; its review remains ongoing and these are not final findings. • Securities businesses with an actual DYFGL client, counterparty, custody or payment relationship should assess exposure and preserve relevant reconciliations; this firm-specific action is not a new general requirement for authorized institutions. Hong Kong Regulatory Developments 🟡 SFC issues restriction notice to DA YUE Financial Group Limited 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20261123-sfc-web-9d3eff0753 ⏰ Deadline: No source deadline stated Products: Investment services, futures On 23 November 2026, the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) issued DA YUE Financial Group Limited (DYFGL) a restriction notice under sections 204 and 205 of the Securities and Futures Ordinance. Without the SFC’s prior written consent, DYFGL cannot conduct the regulated activities for which it is licensed or deal with relevant property, subject to stated exceptions for deposits to its account with an authorized financial institution and consented ordinary-course expenses. The SFC says its initial enquiries indicate an approximately HK$29.6 million client-money shortfall, including client money used for other clients’ futures-margin requirements and trading losses; around 270 active clients hold credit balances. The SFC’s review is ongoing, so the stated concerns are not final findings; for Hong Kong bank securities businesses, the notice is an analogous client-asset and futures-margin control signal where an actual DYFGL relationship exists, rather than a new general requirement. Source: SFC issues restriction notice to DA YUE Financial Group Limited SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. No qualifying benchmark developments were included in this edition. Watch List • Monitor the SFC’s ongoing review of DYFGL and any subsequent public action or client-asset recovery development.
